extraction.document_summary: This brochure describes two Singlife “Supplements” that are designed to boost national long-term care payouts under CareShield Life (CSHL) or ElderShield (ESH). It covers Singlife CareShield Standard and Singlife CareShield Plus. Both provide additional monthly severe disability payouts on top of the underlying government scheme payout (Standard: for inability to perform at least three ADLs; Plus: for inability to perform at least two ADLs). The supplement monthly payout is stated to be S$200 to S$5,000 more each month, with the payout either fixed or increasing (2% or 3% annually). It also adds other components such as an additional monthly “Add-on Benefit” for up to 12 months (triggered by inability to perform 2 ADLs/1 ADL for Standard/Plus), potential lump-sum and death/rehabilitation-related amounts (described as multiple of monthly benefit), plus waiver reliefs for mild disability and MediSave premium payment support.
quality_notes: Document clearly distinguishes Singlife CareShield Standard vs Singlife CareShield Plus by ADL thresholds and provides multiple payout mechanics and time limits.

Some quantitative features (e.g., exact benefit multiples/amount definitions for certain benefits) are stated, but other details are deferred to the referenced Product Summary and are therefore not extracted here.
The brochure uses footnotes and examples; only explicitly stated facts are extracted into structured fields.

policies.quick_summary: A CareShield Life/ElderShield supplement that adds severe disability monthly payouts on top of the government scheme. For Standard, payouts start when the Life Assured cannot perform at least three ADLs, and the extra monthly benefit is stated as S$200 to S$5,000. It can be fixed or increasing (2% or 3% annually). It also includes an Add-on Benefit (up to 12 months) and waiver reliefs for mild disability, with a 90-day deferment period for selected benefits and MediSave premium payment support (up to S$600 per calendar year). Note: Some benefit details are subject to the Product Summary and the Deferment Period.
policies.target_customer: Individuals who already have CareShield Life (CSHL) or ElderShield (ESH) and want to purchase this supplement to boost their national severe disability payouts
coverage_scope: Additional monthly payouts for severe disability on top of CareShield Life or ElderShield payouts
Additional monthly Add-on Benefit (up to 12 months) when unable to perform at least two ADLs
Waiver reliefs if mild disability (unable to perform at least one ADL)
Lump-sum benefit when severely disabled (three times monthly benefit described in brochure)
Death payout that is three times the monthly benefit or rehabilitation benefit (as described)
Dependant Care Benefit and Caregiver Relief Benefit (durations and ADL triggers are described in examples)
policies.eligibility_notes: The brochure states you need a CareShield Life (CSHL) or ElderShield (ESH) policy before purchasing these Supplements.
policies.premium_payment_term_description: Choose a payment period: the brochure states you can pay up to the policy anniversary after turning 98, or pay for a limited time; it also describes two limited-time approaches, including paying up to the policy anniversary after turning 68, or paying for 20 years from entry age (if joining at age 49 or older).
important_caveats: Deferment Period applies for selected benefits.
The monthly benefit is paid after the 90-day Deferment Period, and Waiver of Premium is applicable after the Deferment Period (with a stated waiver condition for the same cause within 180 days).
The policy requires a CSHL or ESH policy before purchase.
